subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] fs: stamp the current time for a stale delegated ctime update

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's inode_set_ctime_deleg function, which drops updates that do not advance the ctime when they are actually valid and should be applied. The patch adds logic to stamp the current time for stale delegated ctime updates, ensuring that the ctime never moves backwards. This fix addresses an issue introduced by a previous patch (3952f1cbcbc4) and is assisted by LLM. The changes affect the fs/inode.c file and are part of a larger series of patches.
